About the job
Quotaloom is a revenue intelligence platform for B2B sales teams. We plug into Salesforce and HubSpot, analyse pipeline and call data and help sales leaders forecast with confidence. Today we are 180 people in Berlin and Barcelona, and more than 900 companies run their weekly pipeline review with Quotaloom.

We are growing our DACH go-to-market team and are looking for Junior Sales Development Representatives who want to start their career in B2B SaaS sales.

What you'll do
- Research target accounts and decision makers in mid-market and enterprise companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland
- Run outbound sequences via phone, email and LinkedIn (around 50 to 60 activities per day)
- Qualify inbound leads from our marketing campaigns and webinars
- Book discovery meetings for our Account Executives and hand them over with clean notes in Salesforce
- Share market feedback with Marketing and Product
- Hit your monthly targets for qualified meetings and pipeline generated

What we're looking for
- 0 to 2 years of experience, for example from an internship or a working student job in sales, customer success or recruiting
- A university degree is nice to have, not a must
- Native-level German and fluent English
- Curiosity, resilience and a good sense of humour when a prospect says no
- Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot is a plus

What we offer
- Base salary of EUR 42,000 to 48,000 plus up to EUR 14,000 variable at target
- Permanent contract after a six-month probation period
- A clear promotion path to Account Executive within 12 to 18 months
- Structured onboarding in our Sales Academy and weekly 1:1 coaching
- Hybrid setup: three days in our Kreuzberg office, two days from home
- 28 vacation days, Urban Sports Club membership and a public transport ticket
- Team offsites twice a year

We believe diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of background, identity or life experience.
